decisions.reason: The large-practice package for the anamnesis app builds on the firm's established offer and fits its announced paperless, digital-practice direction, so prior investment and strategic centrality favor keeping it, and any slow uptake can be attributed to the early adoption phase.

The support service for dental assistants rests on the firm's core strength in customer service, is publicly committed through its own web page, and costs little to maintain, so management will persist with it.
